response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(powerstatus, 'MISSING') as status, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY COALESCE(powerstatus, 'MISSING')), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total FROM status_counts), status_shares AS (SELECT sc.status, sc.telescope_count, CAST(sc.telescope_count AS REAL) / tc.total as share FROM status_counts sc CROSS JOIN total_count tc), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM status_shares), above_average_statuses AS (SELECT ss.telescope_count, ss.share FROM status_shares ss CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE ss.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes_above_average, AVG(share) as average_share_of_above_average, AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share) as how_far_above_average FROM above_average_statuses;
